prompt:
The section sections/pricing-table.liquid prints merchant-entered pricing data. Merchants type stray spaces and empty entries, so the output must be trimmed and cleaned. Implement the rules below. Keep the {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block byte-for-byte unchanged. Inputs: - section.settings.title: string or null. - plans: top-level, an array or null. Each element is an object that always has these keys: - name: string or null. - price: string or null. - features: string or null. It holds features separated by the | character. - highlighted: boolean or null. Rules: 1. A plan is visible only if its name, after stripping leading and trailing whitespace, is non-empty. A null name counts as empty. 2. If there are no visible plans, output nothing at all (empty string). This includes plans being null or an empty array. 3. Otherwise output

    , with the stripped price. If the stripped price is empty, or the price is null, PRICE is the text Contact us. - The feature list (see rule 7). 7. Feature list: split features on |, strip each piece and drop pieces that are empty after stripping. If at least one piece remains, output

Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
